text: Room opened — goal: visualization: Own EXCAVA'S OWN interface — visibility, liveliness, clarity, enjoyment, speed of OUR scre

name: Facet
text: Make the legend a sticky panel anchored to the left edge of the graph. It stays visible at all times so users never hunt for it, which speeds up interpretation and keeps the interface lively. The trade-off is less screen space for data, but clarity beats density when users need to make quick, confident decisions.

name: Pane
text: Pane: A sticky legend still risks crowding the graph when users zoom into dense data clusters, forcing them to scroll or squint—speed and clarity collapse under their own weight. Better: a collapsible sidebar legend triggered by a persistent, small icon; it stays out of the way until needed, then vanishes again. Test it: measure time-to-interpret with and without zoom at 100% and 200% scale.
